title: Belief Envelope
description: The structure of a single governed belief in the Memory Bridge Protocol. Wraps any stored memory (e.g. a Mem0 record) with the trust, decay, reality, provenance, and consensus metadata that turns a memory store into a belief store. The storage engine holds the content; the envelope governs the trust. Required fields form the portable core; optional objects (reality_check, calibration, consensus) carry the domain-grade extensions.

belief_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this belief.

proposition.description: The claim this belief asserts, in natural language.

cell_type.description: The kind of belief. Mirrors the bridge's memory cell types.

source_agent.description: AgentIdentity.id of the agent that asserted this belief.

source_trust_class.description: Trust class of the asserting agent. Determines the confidence ceiling the bridge enforces.

confidence.description: Asserted confidence at write time, 0.0–1.0 float. The bridge clamps this to the source agent's confidence_ceiling (model-class: 0.40). MUST be a floating-point value — integer coercion (Math.round, parseInt, bitwise truncation) corrupts cross-agent belief exchange and is prohibited by all implementations.
confidence.$comment: IEEE-754 float64 required. Implementations MUST: (1) parse with parseFloat(), never parseInt()/Math.round()/Number.toFixed(0); (2) serialise as a decimal fraction (e.g. 0.3500 not 0); (3) validate with typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) before accepting. Python callers MUST annotate the parameter as float. The cumulative confidence error across 50 model-class exchanges (ceiling 0.40) with Math.round coercion is 15.8950 confidence units (100% signal loss) — equivalent to discarding every belief.

epistemic_status.description: Position in the epistemic state machine. Typical transitions: observed|inferred -> contested -> verified | superseded | quarantined.

created_at.description: When the belief was first asserted (RFC 3339).

evidence.description: Provenance chain. The audit asset: where the belief came from and how well it is supported.

refs.description: References to supporting evidence (URIs, filing ids, document ids, transcript ids).

evidence_score.description: Strength of the supporting evidence, 0-1. Low scores trip the immune system's ghost-belief check.

chain_terminates_in_agent_content.description: True if the evidence chain bottoms out in agent-generated content rather than an external source. Signals citation-loop / recursive-collapse risk.

decay.description: Metabolic decay. Belief confidence erodes over time on a half-life appropriate to the information type (rumor: days; SEC fact: a year).

half_life.description: Decay half-life as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. P3D (rumor), P30D (macro forecast), P365D (SEC filing fact).

effective_confidence.description: Confidence after decay is applied at read time. Derived, not asserted.

reality_check.description: Belief mark-to-market. Reconciles the belief against realized ground truth (market data, outcomes). Only domains with continuous ground truth (e.g. trading) can fully populate this.

truth_drift_score.description: Divergence between belief and realized data: 0 (aligned) to 1 (contradicted). Rising drift accelerates decay and raises review priority.

drift_data_ref.description: Reference to the realized data series the belief is marked against (e.g. a ticker or metric series).

calibration.description: Outcome tracking and derived trust. Every resolved belief is a labeled example that recalibrates the source agent's trust weight.

calibration_weight.description: Trust weight DERIVED from the source agent's realized calibration (e.g. rolling Brier score). Not self-asserted, not human-assigned.

consensus.description: Parliament governance. Records multi-agent agreement on durable beliefs. Aggregation should weight by authority, calibration, and evidence quality (not pure majority).

telemetry.description: Observability. Links the belief mutation to an OpenTelemetry GenAI span for audit.

thread_id.description: Namespace the belief was written into.

ttl_days.description: Optional hard expiry in days. The Immune service sweeps beliefs below confidence 0.20; the Metabolic floor is 0.10.
